# Vendored browser libraries

## jsQR

- File: `jsQR.js`
- Version: 1.4.0
- Source: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
- License: Apache License 2.0 (see `jsQR.LICENSE.txt`)

Used as the fallback QR decoder when the browser does not provide
`BarcodeDetector`. Loaded by `frontend/lens.js` through `index.html`.
